pairs.why: B's gold handle and gold trim give the cup the clean, high-contrast build of the real cards, while A's chunky blue handle and foam bubbles at the rim add a slightly toy-like, textured look.
This is the same pair as q016 with sides swapped: the gold-handled cup (A) reads cleaner and closer to the real finish than the foam-rimmed, chunky-handled cup.
A's blue handle has gold collars where it joins the cup, so it looks built like a real object with the kind of small construction detail the vending machine and phone box have; B is a bit plainer.
This is the same pair as q018 with sides swapped: B is the cup with gold collars on the handle joints, which reads as better constructed, like the real cards.
B adds cream metal grommets and a small gold crown emblem on the lid, which matches the trim detail on the real phone box; A is a plainer blank cylinder.
A's cream grommets around the rope holes read as real hardware, while B's navy grommets blend into the lid and make it look more like a plain blank.
